from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/267-18/1_267-18_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/267-18_0_0a86fc7f/1_267-18_output.xlsx")
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Load workbook for editing, and a data_only copy in case the source concatenation cells are formulas
wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Folha1"]
wb_values = load_workbook(input_path, data_only=True)
ws_values = wb_values["Folha1"]

def is_yellow_fill(cell):
    """Detect common Excel yellow fills."""
    fill = cell.fill
    if fill is None or fill.fill_type is None:
        return False

    color = fill.fgColor
    if color is None:
        return False

    if color.type == "rgb" and color.rgb:
        rgb = color.rgb[-6:].upper()
        # Standard yellow plus common light-yellow highlights
        return rgb in {"FFFF00", "FFF2CC", "FFFF99", "FFE699", "FFF200"}

    if color.type == "indexed" and color.indexed is not None:
        # Excel indexed color 6 is yellow
        return color.indexed == 6

    return False

def row_is_yellow(row_num):
    """Treat the row as highlighted if any used cell in that row has yellow fill."""
    for col in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        if is_yellow_fill(ws.cell(row=row_num, column=col)):
            return True
    return False

def build_concat_from_row(row_num):
    """Fallback model matching the visible concatenation pattern in column F."""
    link = ws.cell(row=row_num, column=4).value or ""
    base_path = ws.cell(row=1, column=1).value or ""
    path = ws.cell(row=row_num, column=1).value or ""
    alt = ws.cell(row=row_num, column=2).value or ""
    return f'["{link}", "{base_path}/{path}", "{alt}", "{path}"],'

# Only modify the allowed answer range G1:G2
for row in range(1, 3):
    # Source concatenation is in column F, based on the sheet preview
    source = ws_values.cell(row=row, column=6).value
    if source is None or (isinstance(source, str) and source.startswith("=")):
        source = ws.cell(row=row, column=6).value
    if source is None or (isinstance(source, str) and source.startswith("=")):
        source = build_concat_from_row(row)

    source = str(source)

    if row_is_yellow(row):
        ws.cell(row=row, column=7).value = source if source.startswith("//") else "//" + source
    else:
        ws.cell(row=row, column=7).value = source

wb.save(output_path)
